chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Hammad from Isma'il ibn Jabir said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I perform Witr after the dawn rises?' He said, 'No.'
ai.seo_question: When should the Witr prayer be performed relative to the rising of Fajr?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Witr prayer is not performed after the dawn (Fajr) has fully risen, establishing it as a prayer of the night that concludes with the onset of morning. This ruling aligns with the Shia view that Witr is a confirmed Sunnah linked to the night prayers, distinct from the Fajr prayer, and must be completed before the time for Fajr begins or at its very inception, ensuring it retains its identity as a 'night' prayer.
